exposure: High-density dose delivery (24 doses per session within 15 min)
Standard-density dose delivery (24 doses per session within 30 min)
cohort: Twenty children receiving Enhanced Conversational Recast methods to treat morphological errors participated in the study.
finding: While the treatment was effective overall, there were no significant differences in outcomes between the high-density and standard-density dose delivery methods, suggesting performance does not suffer from compressed dose rates.
